_comment: Curated on-computer models (R16). Every entry: Apache-2.0 or MIT licence only, instruction-tuned, OpenAI-style tool calling through llama.cpp --jinja, GGUF Q4_K_M. url is pinned to a Hugging Face commit; sizeBytes + sha256 are that commit's LFS size + oid (verified 2026-10-15 via the HF API /tree/main). minRamBytes = sizeBytes + 1.5 GiB (1610612736) headroom for an 8k-token KV cache + llama-server runtime. diskNeededBytes = sizeBytes + 10%, rounded up.
_recommendedByTier_comment: PROVISIONAL defaults; the lead sets the final ones after on-device measurement.

models.name: IBM Granite 4.2 3B
